name: Retezat
description: Around eighty glacial lakes in one range, including the deepest and the largest in the country. It was Romania's first national park, declared in 1935, and the core reserve is still closed to casual walkers. Chamois and brown bear are both here in numbers.
getting: Car to Cârnic or Gura Zlata, then walk in — there is no road through. Bukura Lake is six hours from the trailhead. Register at the park office.
